description: Allowlisted tools for the verl tuning agents

skills.name: parameter_understanding
skills.description: Query curated verl parameter semantics, memory/throughput effects, interactions, and hard constraints. Query every parameter you intend to change when its effect is uncertain.

items.description: Complete Hydra parameter names to query

skills.name: tuning_strategies
skills.description: Query stage-aware strategies for a measured bottleneck or failure scenario.

skills.name: memory_estimator
skills.description: Estimate phase memory effects from an explicit measured reference trial. Each rollout, actor-log-prob, ref-log-prob, and training result reports a status, measured reference peak MiB, estimated candidate peak MiB, and estimated relative change percent. The tool reports memory safety and may conditionally remind callers to evaluate a larger target, but it does not choose the tuning direction. Pass only canonical from/to changes and reference_trial_id. The real resource gate remains authoritative.

changes.description: Changed Hydra parameters. Every value must contain from (the explicit value in the reference trial, or null if absent) and to (the target value).

from.description: Value in the selected reference trial; use null only when the parameter is absent there

to.description: Candidate target value used by the estimator

reference_trial_id.description: Required trial whose parameters and measured phase peaks are the proportional-estimation baseline

skills.name: analyze_rollout_metrics
skills.description: Analyze one recorded trial's compact vLLM metrics and determine whether gpu_memory_utilization, max_num_seqs, or max_num_batched_tokens has direct binding evidence. Use before proposing or approving changes to those rollout capacity knobs. The result distinguishes GPU compute utilization from the vLLM memory budget, treats missing exporter metrics as unknown, and returns one-change-per-trial guardrails.

trial_id.description: Recorded reference trial whose rollout metrics and exact parameters should be analyzed

skills.name: live_gpu_snapshot
skills.description: Read a safe instantaneous GPU snapshot through nvidia-smi, xpu-smi, or GPU_SMI. This is host occupancy evidence, not phase-specific training memory.

skills.name: search_verl_docs
skills.description: Search bounded local verl 0.7 documentation, config, examples, and worker source for parameter definitions or behavior.

query.description: Parameter name or technical search phrase

skills.name: query_trial_history
skills.description: Read 1-5 reference trials by ID. Returns current-stage editable parameter values, recorded changes, and compact hardware or stability metrics in the requested order. Stability results include the MATH validation step/value series.

skills.name: read_trial_log_excerpt
skills.description: Read a bounded excerpt from a log path already recorded for a trial. No arbitrary path is accepted.

skills.name: read_trial_metrics
skills.description: Read ordered, bounded per-step stability metrics exclusively from a trial's structured metrics.json. Returns aligned windows for requested training metrics and automatically includes the MATH validation step/value series in the same step range.

skills.name: read_current_trial_metrics
skills.description: Read ordered, bounded metrics from the currently running trial at the immutable snapshot step supplied by the runner. The result automatically includes the MATH validation step/value series through that snapshot. Use a coarse window for the full trajectory and window_size=1 around the trigger or scheduled follow-up. The tool never accepts a file path or a different trial ID.
